title: Public Health Alert: Parasite and Measles Outbreaks Cause Concern Across the U.S.
subtitle: Health experts are working to control the spread of illnesses while monitoring new developments in medical policy.

summary.en: The United States is currently facing a significant health challenge due to a widespread parasite outbreak. Known as cyclosporiasis, this illness has affected people in 15 states. Additionally, health officials are responding to a measles outbreak in New Mexico. Experts are working to identify the sources of these infections to prevent further harm. Meanwhile, journalists are also tracking important changes to national health policies.
summary.zh: 美國目前正面臨一項由廣泛寄生蟲疫情所引發的重大健康挑戰。這種稱為環孢子蟲症的疾病已影響了十五個州的民眾。此外，衛生官員也正針對新墨西哥州的麻疹疫情做出回應。專家正致力於釐清這些感染源以防止進一步危害。與此同時，新聞工作者也持續追蹤國家醫療政策的重要變革。

paragraphs.en: Public health officials in the United States are currently working to manage two separate health concerns that are affecting communities across the country. A serious parasite outbreak, known as cyclosporiasis, has now spread to 15 states. At the same time, a measles outbreak has been reported in New Mexico. These events have drawn significant attention from medical experts who are trying to track the sources of these illnesses and protect the public.
paragraphs.zh: 美國的公共衛生官員目前正致力於處理兩項影響全國社區的健康隱憂。一種稱為環孢子蟲症的嚴重寄生蟲疫情，目前已擴散至十五個州。與此同時，新墨西哥州也傳出了麻疹疫情。這些事件引起了醫學專家的極大關注，他們正試圖追蹤這些疾病的來源，以保護大眾健康。

paragraphs.en: According to reports from KFF Health News, the cyclosporiasis outbreak is linked to contaminated fresh produce. This illness is caused by a tiny parasite that enters the body through food. The situation has become quite serious, with health officials noting that the outbreak has already led to more than 500 hospitalizations. Tragically, there have also been two deaths connected to this specific health event. Because the parasite is often found in fresh fruits and vegetables, experts are focusing their efforts on identifying exactly which food items are responsible for the spread of the infection.
paragraphs.zh: 根據凱瑟健康新聞（KFF Health News）的報導，環孢子蟲症疫情與受污染的生鮮農產品有關。這種疾病是由一種透過食物進入人體的微小寄生蟲所引起。情況已變得相當嚴重，衛生官員指出，這波疫情已導致超過五百人住院。令人遺憾的是，這起特定的健康事件也造成了兩起死亡案例。由於這種寄生蟲常存在於新鮮蔬果中，專家正集中精力釐清究竟是哪些食品導致了感染的傳播。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the parasite outbreak, there is growing concern regarding measles in New Mexico. Measles is a highly contagious disease that causes a fever and a skin rash. It is considered a serious public health issue because it can spread very quickly among people who have not been vaccinated. Céline Gounder, an editor-at-large for public health at KFF Health News, recently discussed the situation in New Mexico during an appearance on CBS News. Her comments highlight the ongoing efforts by health authorities to contain the virus and prevent it from reaching more people.
paragraphs.zh: 除了寄生蟲疫情外，新墨西哥州的麻疹問題也日益受到關注。麻疹是一種傳染性極高的疾病，會導致發燒與皮膚出疹。由於它能在未接種疫苗的人群中迅速擴散，因此被視為嚴重的公共衛生問題。凱瑟健康新聞的公共衛生特約編輯席琳·岡德（Céline Gounder）近期在哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網（CBS News）節目中討論了新墨西哥州的情況。她的評論凸顯了衛生當局為控制病毒並防止其擴散至更多民眾所做的持續努力。

paragraphs.en: These health emergencies are happening at the same time that other major changes are occurring in the American healthcare system. Journalists are also keeping a close watch on how these policies might affect patients. For example, KFF Health News chief Washington correspondent Julie Rovner recently spoke about the end of a government subsidy for Medicare Part D. A subsidy is a payment from the government that helps lower the cost of something for the public. In this case, the change could mean that some people will have to pay more for their prescription medicines.
paragraphs.zh: 這些突發的健康危機正值美國醫療體系發生其他重大變革之際。新聞工作者也密切關注這些政策可能對病患造成的影響。例如，凱瑟健康新聞的華盛頓首席特派員茱莉·羅夫納（Julie Rovner）近期談到了聯邦醫療保險（Medicare）D 部分政府補助的終止。補助是指政府提供的款項，旨在協助民眾降低特定項目的費用。在此案例中，這項變動可能意味著部分民眾必須支付更高的處方藥費用。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, there is a debate regarding new work requirements for people who receive Medicaid. Medicaid is a government program that provides health insurance to low-income individuals. Some states are now asking doctors to document which patients are too sick to work. KFF Health News Southern correspondent Sam Whitehead reported that many doctors feel uncomfortable with this new responsibility. They are worried about the difficulty of deciding who is healthy enough to work and who is not. This adds another layer of stress to a healthcare system that is already dealing with the challenges of the current parasite and measles outbreaks.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，關於領取醫療補助計畫（Medicaid）民眾的新工作要求也引發了爭論。醫療補助計畫是一項為低收入戶提供健康保險的政府方案。部分州政府目前要求醫師記錄哪些病患因病無法工作。凱瑟健康新聞的南部特派員山姆·懷特黑德（Sam Whitehead）報導指出，許多醫師對這項新職責感到不安。他們擔心難以判定誰的健康狀況足以工作，誰則不然。這為已經在應對當前寄生蟲與麻疹疫情挑戰的醫療體系，增添了另一層壓力。

paragraphs.en: As the situation continues to develop, health experts are urging the public to stay informed. For the cyclosporiasis outbreak, it is important to wash fresh produce thoroughly, although experts are still working to find the exact source of the contamination. For measles, the best way to prevent the illness is through vaccination. Public health agencies are continuing to monitor the data and provide updates to help keep communities safe.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著情況持續發展，健康專家呼籲大眾保持關注。針對環孢子蟲症疫情，徹底清洗生鮮農產品至關重要，儘管專家仍在努力尋找污染的確切來源。至於麻疹，預防該疾病的最佳方式是接種疫苗。公共衛生機構將持續監控數據並提供最新資訊，以協助維護社區安全。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the combination of these disease outbreaks and changing government policies creates a complex environment for both patients and medical professionals. The focus remains on stopping the spread of infections while ensuring that people still have access to the care they need. Journalists and health officials will continue to provide updates as more information becomes available. For now, the priority for everyone is to follow the advice of health experts and take necessary precautions to stay healthy.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這些疾病疫情與政府政策變動的結合，為病患與醫療專業人員創造了一個複雜的環境。目前的重點仍是阻止感染擴散，同時確保民眾能持續獲得所需的照護。隨著更多資訊揭露，新聞工作者與衛生官員將持續提供最新報導。目前對所有人而言，首要之務是遵循健康專家的建議，並採取必要的預防措施以保持健康。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Attracted or pulled the attention of someone.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「畫畫」或「拉」，這裡指吸引注意力。文中：These events have drawn significant attention from medical experts who are trying to track the sources of these illnesses and protect the public.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To monitor something carefully and continuously.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定搭配的片語，字面上是「保持一個近距離的觀察」，實際指持續且謹慎地監控。文中：Journalists are also keeping a close watch on how these policies might affect patients.

keyTerms.definitionEn: An additional level or complexity added to a situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（層次，如蛋糕），這裡比喻為壓力的疊加。文中：This adds another layer of stress to a healthcare system that is already dealing with the challenges of the current parasite and measles outbreaks.

Health officials report over 500 hospitalizations and two deaths linked to this outbreak. Meanwhile, a separate issue involving raw milk has caused over 100 people to become sick in Idaho. Authorities are working hard to track the source of these infections and protect the public.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the cyclosporiasis outbreak according to the article?

options.A: It has been traced to a specific type of imported fruit.
options.B: It has resulted in over 500 hospitalizations and two deaths.
options.C: It is primarily affecting people in New Mexico.
options.D: It is being managed by a new government subsidy program.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，文中明確提到 cyclosporiasis 疫情已導致超過 500 人住院以及兩起死亡案例。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章僅提到專家正在努力尋找確切的污染來源，尚未鎖定特定水果。選項 C 錯誤，因為文章將 cyclosporiasis 與 measles（發生於新墨西哥州）分開討論。選項 D 錯誤，因為政府補貼政策與此疫情無直接關聯。

quiz.question: Why might doctors feel 'uncomfortable' with the new Medicaid work requirements?

options.A: They believe that work requirements will cause the measles outbreak to worsen.
options.B: They are required to pay for the government subsidies themselves.
options.C: They find it difficult and stressful to objectively determine a patient's capacity to work.
options.D: They disagree with the government's decision to stop funding prescription medicines.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，醫生對於評估病患是否「健康到足以工作」感到不適，因為這增加了他們的壓力，且難以做出判斷。選項 A 無法從文中推論，因為工作要求與傳染病防治無直接因果關係。選項 B 與 D 均屬於對文章中其他政策的誤解，文中並未提到醫生需要負擔補貼費用或反對藥物補助政策。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'subsidy' mean in the context of Medicare Part D?

options.A: A financial contribution from the government to reduce costs.
options.B: A tax increase imposed on medical professionals.
options.C: A new regulation regarding hospital hygiene.
options.D: A penalty for patients who do not have insurance.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文章第四段明確定義了 subsidy 為「政府提供的款項，旨在幫助大眾降低某項事物的成本」。選項 B、C、D 皆與文中定義的「降低成本的政府補助」意義完全相反或無關，屬於對詞彙定義的誤解。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To provide a medical guide on how to treat cyclosporiasis at home.
options.B: To argue that the American healthcare system should be completely privatized.
options.C: To explain the history of vaccine development in the United States.
options.D: To discuss current public health challenges and policy changes affecting the U.S. healthcare landscape.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章開頭提到公共衛生問題，隨後討論了疾病爆發（寄生蟲與麻疹）以及醫療政策變動（Medicare 補貼與 Medicaid 工作要求），最後總結這些因素共同構成了一個複雜的醫療環境。選項 A 太過狹隘；選項 B 文中並未提出此論點；選項 C 僅提到疫苗是預防麻疹的方法，並非文章主旨。
